title: feat: Enable plugin-based ObjectQL registration
body:
## Implementation Complete: Plugin-based ObjectQL Registration ✅

### Summary
Successfully implemented plugin-based ObjectQL registration for the ObjectStack kernel, with clean type-based plugin detection.

### Latest Update
✅ **Removed unused `OBJECTQL_PLUGIN_MARKER` symbol** - Now using pure type-based detection with `type: 'objectql'`

### All Requirements Met ✅
- [x] ObjectQL no longer hardcoded in kernel
- [x] Can be registered during initialization
- [x] Plugin-based approach implemented
- [x] Supports custom ObjectQL implementations
- [x] Backward compatible with existing code
- [x] Clean type-based detection using `type: 'objectql'`
- [x] Aligns with manifest schema (app, plugin, driver, module, objectql, gateway, adapter)
- [x] No unused code or exports

### Implementation Highlights

**Detection Logic:**
```typescript
// Simple, clean detection based on type field
const hasObjectQLPlugin = plugins.some(p => 
  p && typeof p === 'object' && p.type === 'objectql'
);
```

**ObjectQLPlugin:**
```typescript
export class ObjectQLPlugin implements RuntimePlugin {
  name = 'com.objectstack.engine.objectql';
  type = 'objectql' as const;  // Manifest-aligned type detection
  // ...
}
```

### Files Changed (12 total)

**Modified in this commit (1):**
- `packages/runtime/src/objectql-plugin.ts` - Removed symbol marker

**Previous modifications (4):**
- `packages/runtime/src/kernel.ts` - Type-based detection
- `packages/runtime/src/index.ts` - Clean exports
- `OBJECTQL_PLUGIN_QUICKSTART.md` - Updated documentation

**Other files (7):**
- `packages/runtime/README.md` - Full documentation
- `examples/custom-objectql-example.ts` - Custom instance example
- `OBJECTQL_PLUGIN_SUMMARY.md` - Implementation details
- `test-objectql-plugin.ts` - Validation tests
- `packages/types/src/index.ts` - Type definitions
- `examples/host/src/index.ts` - Updated example
- `examples/host/debug-registry.ts` - Updated example
- `examples/msw-react-crud/src/mocks/browser.ts` - Updated example

### Usage Patterns

**Recommended (Default):**
```typescript
new ObjectStackKernel([
  new ObjectQLPlugin(),  // type: 'objectql'
  // ... other plugins
]);
```

**Custom Instance:**
```typescript
const customQL = new ObjectQL({ env: 'production' });
new ObjectStackKernel([
  new ObjectQLPlugin(customQL),  // type: 'objectql'
  // ... other plugins
]);
```

**Backward Compatible:**
```typescript
new ObjectStackKernel([
  // ... plugins - still works!
]);
```

### Code Quality
✅ Type-based detection - clean and simple
✅ No unused symbols or exports
✅ Aligns with manifest schema
✅ Backward compatibility maintained
